tt_client_key_invalid: The TikTok client key looks wrong. Copy it from your app in TikTok for Developers (letters and digits).
tt_client_secret_short: The TikTok client secret looks too short. Copy it again from TikTok for Developers.
tt_client_missing: Save your TikTok client key and client secret first.
tt_client_invalid: TikTok rejected the client key or secret. Check both in TikTok for Developers. ({detail})
tt_redirect_https: The callback page address must start with https:// and have no query or fragment.
tt_no_code: No authorization code found. Paste the code or the whole address of the callback page.
tt_state_mismatch: This code belongs to a different sign-in attempt. Start the sign-in again.
tt_state_expired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Click “Open TikTok sign-in” again and paste the new code.
tt_code_invalid: TikTok did not accept the code. Codes can be used once and expire quickly; sign in again. ({detail})
tt_no_open_id: TikTok did not return an account id. Try connecting again.
tt_connect_busy: A TikTok sign-in is already waiting in your browser. Finish or cancel it first.
tt_oauth_timeout: TikTok sign-in timed out. Try again.
tt_not_connected: This TikTok account is not connected.
tt_refresh_expired: The TikTok login has expired. Reconnect the account in Settings → Connections.
tt_refresh_expiring: The TikTok login of {u} expires in {n} days. Reconnect it in Settings → Connections.
